name: penpot_sync
description: Penpot Sync — Nextcloud frontend (Files row icon + Open in Penpot action)
comment: src/files.js registers ONE file action, "Open in Penpot", and deliberately no text-editor opener — a .penpot archive has no coherent hand-edit (saga §6.1). That omission is why this frontend is a fraction of the size of nextcloud-grafana's.
